pages.title: Let's say hi to Colombia!
pages.subtitle: Reading + Speaking · Cartagena de Indias
pages.imageAlt: Murallas y calles coloniales de Cartagena
pages.intro: Lee los tres diálogos, escucha el audio y fíjate en cómo se saludan y se presentan.

sections.title: Reading — Three short dialogues in Cartagena
sections.instructions: Lee y escucha cada diálogo. Fíjate en la diferencia entre el saludo formal y el informal.

items.label: Dialogue A — Formal
items.context: Dos profesionales se conocen frente a las murallas.

lines.speaker: Camila
lines.text: Good morning. I'm Camila Restrepo, from the tourism office of Cartagena.

lines.speaker: Andrés
lines.text: Good morning, Ms. Restrepo. My name is Andrés Baena. It's a pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: Camila
lines.text: Nice to meet you too, Mr. Baena. Welcome to the walled city.

lines.speaker: Andrés
lines.text: Thank you very much. How are you today?

lines.speaker: Camila
lines.text: I'm very well, thank you. Shall we start the tour?

items.label: Dialogue B — Informal
items.context: Dos jóvenes se encuentran camino a Bocagrande.

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: Hey, Felipe! Hi! How are you?

lines.speaker: Felipe
lines.text: Hi, Vale! I'm great, thanks. And you?

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: Pretty good! Are you going to the beach?

lines.speaker: Felipe
lines.text: Yes, my cousins are waiting for me. See you there!

items.label: Dialogue C — Introducing a friend
items.context: Mariana presenta a su amiga en la Plaza de los Coches.

lines.speaker: Mariana
lines.text: Hi, Santiago! This is my friend Juliana. She's from Medellín.

lines.speaker: Santiago
lines.text: Hello, Juliana! Nice to meet you. I'm Santiago.

lines.speaker: Juliana
lines.text: Nice to meet you too, Santiago. Where are you from?

lines.speaker: Santiago
lines.text: I'm from Cartagena. Welcome to my city!

sections.title: Who says what?
sections.instructions: Empareja cada diálogo (A, B, C) con las personas correctas.

sections.title: Listening — Mariana's day
sections.instructions: Escucha el audio y responde las preguntas.

transcript.speaker: Mariana
transcript.text: Good afternoon! My name is Mariana. I'm from Bogotá, but I live in Cali now.

transcript.speaker: Mariana
transcript.text: I work in a coffee shop near the park. I start at two in the afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Mariana
transcript.text: When people arrive, I say "Good afternoon". At eight in the evening, I say "Good evening".

transcript.speaker: Mariana
transcript.text: And when I go home at ten, my grandmother always says "Good night, mija".

questions.q: What time does she start work?

sections.title: How are you REALLY doing?
sections.instructions: Lanza el dado y responde "How are you?" de una forma diferente cada vez.
